headlines.title: 3 Dividend Stocks To Own In November 2026
headlines.summary: With Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller publicly backing another interest rate hike in December, and even floating a larger move if inflation stays firm, cash in the bank looks safer but hardly rewarding. Reliable income from well covered dividends becomes more appealing when borrowing costs rise and volatility returns. This article walks through three high yielding companies from our income screen that offer 3%+ payouts backed by steady distributions.

headlines.title: QatarEnergy to acquire 25% stake in Namibia’s PEL82 licence
headlines.summary: Chevron will remain operator with 55%, while existing partners Namcor E&P and Custos Energy will each retain 10%.

headlines.title: Sintana Energy: Qatar Energy farms into Namibia project in deal with Chevron
headlines.summary: Sintana Energy Inc (TSX-V:SEI, OTCQB:SEUSF, FRA:3ZX1, AIM:SEI) has gained a new partner in the Walvis Basin, in the PEL 82 exploration licence offshore Namibia, where QatarEnergy has agreed to buy a 25% stake from Chevron.

headlines.title: PEL 82 - QatarEnergy to Acquire 25% Participating Interest from Chevron
headlines.summary: TORONTO, ON AND LONDON, UK / ACCESS Newswire / November 10, 2026 / (TSXV:SEI)(AIM:SEI)(OTCQX:SEUSF) ("Sintana" or the "Company") notes the announcement that QatarEnergy has agreed to acquire a 25% participating interest in Petroleum Exploration Licence 82 ("PEL 82"), offshore Namibia, from an affiliate of Chevron Corporation ("Chevron"). ("Custos") holds a 10% participating interest in PEL 82 and Sintana maintains a 49% indirect interest in Custos.

headlines.summary: These integrated energy giants are built to survive the entire energy cycle.

description: Chevron Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy and chemicals operations. It operates through Upstream and Downstream segments. The Upstream segment engages in the exploration for, development, production, and transportation of crude oil and natural gas; processing, liquefaction, transportation, and regasification of liquefied natural gas; transportation of crude oil through pipelines; transportation, storage, and marketing of natural gas; carbon capture and storage; and operation of a gas-to-liquids plant. The Downstream segment refines crude oil into petroleum products; markets crude oil, refined products, and lubricants; manufactures and markets renewable fuels; transports crude oil and refined products through pipeline, marine vessel, motor equipment, and rail car; and manufactures and markets commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses, and fuel and lubricant additives. The company operates in North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The company was formerly known as ChevronTexaco Corporation and changed its name to Chevron Corporation in May 2005. Chevron Corporation was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
